text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Driver-level randomization leaks across arms in dispatch test","detail":"Dispatch assignment draws on a shared driver and order supply pool, so randomizing by driver leaks effects between arms. Standards require switchback, geo, or market-level designs for routing and dispatch changes.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference"],"recommendation":"Use a switchback, geo, or market/zone-level design and account for spillover between neighboring zones."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Test duration under 14 days","detail":"The test runs for 5 days, which is below the 14-day minimum needed to cover two weekly cycles. No Data Science sign-off for a shorter test is recorded.","evidence_quote":"Run for 5 days.","citations":["experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality"],"recommendation":"Run for at least 14 days, or obtain and record Data Science sign-off for a shorter run."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"No MDE, power, sample size, or stopping rule pre-registered","detail":"The plan only says to compare on-time rate between arms. It does not state an MDE, sample size or power, or a stopping rule, all of which pre-registration requires.","evidence_quote":"Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Pre-register the primary metric, MDE, sample size/power, and stopping rule before launch."}]}
